blocks.text: Here is a short update on the reputation audit, and one request.

We have finished our first pass through the public record for {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}}: its announcements, investor materials and website, set against the news and online coverage Kimberly Le has gathered over the same period. That coverage is now coded by tone and topic. It gives us a working baseline to test in the interviews. A few themes already recur; we will bring them to you once the interviews have confirmed or challenged them.

The interviews come next. We have a draft guide for the leadership conversations and a draft list of external names, made up of investors, analysts and reporters who follow the company. No one outside the company has been contacted, and no one will be until you approve the name. Each leadership conversation should take under an hour and can be held by video if that suits your team better.

The request is your review of that list, which I will send separately this afternoon. Please mark any names to add or drop, and note anyone you would prefer to contact first yourself. Once we have it back, we will start scheduling the leadership interviews.
